title: TestMain harness and DSP primitive tests - walk bounds and mean-reversion, allpass magnitude-flat, tilt response, voice decorrelation, CMakeLists registration
description:
Sole CMakeLists.txt owner for phase b. Add tests/TestMain.cpp + tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp and register new DSP sources + a console test target.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt from phase a (juce_add_plugin target_sources pattern, SHREDWIDTH_CONFIGURE_ONLY)
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width tests or CMake test target patterns if present
- Source/DSP/{RandomWalk,AllpassChain,TiltFilter,Voice}.* public APIs from b.1–b.4
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §14 items 6–9 (walk bounds, correlation-time sanity, decorrelation, tightness monotonicity)

Implement:
1. CMakeLists.txt updates ONLY:
   - Add Source/DSP/RandomWalk.cpp AllpassChain.cpp TiltFilter.cpp Voice.cpp to the ShredDouble plugin target_sources
   - Add juce_add_console_app or add_executable test target (e.g. ShredDoubleTests) with tests/TestMain.cpp and tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp, link needed juce modules + same include dirs, add_test(NAME ... COMMAND ...)
   - Do not remove existing plugin sources; do not invent Engine/DriftDisplay files yet
2. tests/TestMain.cpp: minimal Catch2-free or lightweight main that runs registered tests (prefer simple assert macros / functions returning int failures — no new package manager deps; if JUCE UnitTest runner is already the project style, match it)
3. tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp covering:
   - RandomWalk: long-run samples stay within delay [10,35] ms and pitch ±C_max; mean near nominal; tightness 1.0 yields near-zero excursion vs tightness 0.0; same seed ⇒ identical sequence; PRNG path does not require random_device
   - AllpassChain: impulse response energy roughly preserved (magnitude-flat-ish: output RMS within tolerance of input for white/impulse unit energy); different voice indices produce different IRs (decorrelated phase)
   - TiltFilter: +tilt vs -tilt diverge in high vs low band energy at pivot ~700 Hz for a multi-tone or noise probe
   - Voice: two voices with distinct indices, same mono impulse/noise input, cross-correlation of outputs below a loose threshold; process path runs without throw for N samples after prepare

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY allowed_write_paths (CMakeLists.txt + the two test files).
acceptance_criteria: CMakeLists.txt registers Source/DSP/RandomWalk.cpp Source/DSP/AllpassChain.cpp Source/DSP/TiltFilter.cpp Source/DSP/Voice.cpp on the plugin target
CMakeLists.txt defines a test executable target including tests/TestMain.cpp and tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp and registers it with add_test
tests/TestMain.cpp exists as the test harness entrypoint
tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp exists and contains tests for RandomWalk bounds/mean/seed determinism and tightness depth scaling
tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp contains AllpassChain magnitude/energy and per-voice distinctness checks
tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp contains TiltFilter response check and Voice dual-voice decorrelation or dual-process smoke check
No new third-party package manager dependencies are introduced
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/** implementation files (owned by b.1–b.4)
modify the eight reused ShredWidth DSP/GUI files
add AU format or unrelated plugin targets
fetch Catch2/GoogleTest via FetchContent unless already present in repo pattern — prefer header-free asserts

allowed: lightweight assert-based test harness without new deps
juce_add_console_app or plain add_executable for tests
loose numeric tolerances for FFTless decorrelation/energy checks
forbidden: rewrite entire CMakeLists from scratch unrelated to registration
implement DSP logic inside test files beyond exercising public APIs
register ShredDoubleEngine/DriftDisplay sources not yet created
